output.kth: Distinct sorted span including zero, optional if index out of range

constraints.allocation: size_t and vector max_size / available memory limits additionally apply
constraints.semantics: Complete API, numeric, lifetime, threading and state conditions in docs/REPOSITORY_ASSETS.md
constraints.errors: Bad index/range or endpoint throws; overflow explicitly checked; allocations may throw
constraints.enumeration: No multiplicity, nonempty-subset interpretation, witness or deletion; full rank permits all uint64 indices

complexity.space: 512-byte rows + size_t rank; kth local 512 bytes; no heap

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative payload lower bound, not peak memory feasibility; 64-bit platform costs in documentation

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formal verification

provenance.implementation: Rewritten modern C++20 for this project, not source-code copy
